id.description: Persistent ID: unique across a map's object collections; document IDs unique across a bundle.

key.description: Catalog and contract key; same grammar as IDs.

coordinate.description: World units on the 1/16 WU quantum within ±131,072 WU (2^17).

length.description: Positive length on the 1/16 WU quantum, at most 262,144 WU (2^18).

rect.description: x, y, width, height in WU; the far edges must also stay within range.

ticks.description: Duration in integer ticks at the declared 60 Hz.

path.description: Bundle-root-relative POSIX path of portable filename characters; reserved device names and case aliases are semantic errors.

asset-scale.description: WU per asset pixel or SVG viewBox unit; positive scale on the 1/65536 quantum.

asset-size.description: Decoded pixel size, SVG viewBox size, or [0, 0] for audio.
